rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a male monarch or national ruler.

example.english: That king ruled the country for decades.
example.traditional: 嗰個國王統治咗個國家幾十年。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 gwok3 wong4 tung2 zi6 zo2 go3 gwok3 gaa1 gei2 sap6 nin4

rows.note: Use this shorter term in titles or names for a king and for the king chess piece.

example.english: My king is in check—save it quickly!
example.traditional: 我隻王俾人將軍喇，快啲救返佢！
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 wong4 bei2 jan4 zoeng1 gwan1 laa3 faai3 di1 gau3 faan1 keoi5

rows.note: This is the transparent everyday term for a king playing card.

example.jyutping: ngo5 cau1 dou2 zo2 zoeng1 kei1 paai4

rows.note: In card-game speech, this phonetic term can name the king playing card, alongside K牌.

example.english: I have a king, so there’s no need to worry.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 zoeng1 king1 m4 sai2 geng1
